text:
A warning for those considering orthodontic treatment:

We chose this clinic for our braces treatment.
We trusted that we would receive care from experts, but our experience was very disappointing.

From the first day of treatment, we felt that our concerns were not taken seriously. There was no prior explanation of the treatment process. During the procedure, it felt very quick and painful, yet there was no inquiry about our readiness or feelings.

After the braces were fitted, we discovered that not all brackets were attached, causing suspicion and concern. We repeatedly contacted the clinic to inquire, and also reported loose teeth and our discomfort.

The most disappointing thing was that when we frankly stated that we were unsure and hesitant to return to the original dentist due to fear and stress from our past experience, the clinic insisted that we see the same dentist repeatedly without answering our questions or offering any alternative solutions.

Ultimately, we had to spend time consulting other clinics and may incur additional costs for transferring our case, even though the main problem stemmed from our complete loss of confidence in the treatment.

We want to warn everyone: Before choosing a clinic, don't just look at price, promotions, or reputation. Consider communication, listening skills, and attentiveness to the patient. These are crucial when problems arise.

This is our personal experience. Anyone considering choosing an orthodontic clinic, please be aware. Please do your research and read reviews from various sources carefully.
author_name: Pitchanan Sukperee
